title: ps: fix label lookup in container and pod table headings
body:
Table headings for `podman ps` and `podman pod ps` use a plain`map[string]string`. A table template that calls `.Label` with an argument fails while rendering the headings, before listing rows are printed. 
For example: `podman ps --format 'table {{.Label "app"}}'`

Add a shared `PsHeader` type in `cmd/podman/common` with a `Label` method that returns the requested label name as the column heading. Use this type for both container and pod listings.

Add container unit tests and extend the existing container and pod e2e tests to check label headings, label values, missing labels, unlabeled objects and `--noheading` output.

Fixes: #29831
